summary: Need a single-unit 'next up from chosen target' mode (native NextUpFromTarget; enemyNextDown exists, enemyAboveTarget is all above) or per-target chance on status segments. Native 8485: CauseSilence@FromTarget, @NextUpFromTarget, @NextDownFromTarget, each an independent 30% roll. Curated can only write inflict(chosen,0.3)+inflict(enemyChosenAndAdjacent,0.3): segment chance is one roll for the whole segment, so both neighbours are silenced together or not at all. Fix in curated after primitive: silence chosen 0.3, enemyNextUp 0.3, enemyNextDown 0.3.
repro: castSpell({key:'troop:6982', seed:s}) over many seeds: E10 and E12 always get silence together (never exactly one)

summary: enemyBelowTarget/enemyAboveTarget return [] once the chosen target died earlier in the same cast (targeting.ts anchors on the chosen unit's formation index and bails out if it is not found). Native 9385: Damage@FromTarget then CauseBleed@BelowTarget; enemies below a killed target should still be Bled. Anchor should use the target's slot at selection time (or keep defeated units as anchors).
repro: castSpell({key:'weapon:1605', enemies: 4 x {hp:1,maxHp:1,armor:0}}) -> dmg E11 25; defeat E11; no Bleed on E12/E13 (L10 bleeds both)

summary: Modifier source boardSpecial has no colour filter, so native CountGems Dragon<Color> (R009: dragonGem carries its base colour) cannot be expressed. Curated 9527 (DragonBlue x8) and 9494 (DragonPurple x6) count every Blue/Purple gem instead (L10 Luther deals 100 = 12 + 8 x 11). Needs boardSpecial { gem, color? } (and the same for Giant<Color> counts); then curated switches to { kind:'boardSpecial', gem:'dragonGem', color }.
repro: castSpell({key:'troop:7626'}) on the default board (no Dragon gems) -> dmg 100 to all; expected 12
